About

I’m a student in the Faculty of Veterinary Science at Bangladesh Agricultural University, currently in Level 2, Semester 1.

Photography is my other way of paying attention. I shoot the places around me: the fog on the river at dawn, flowers on campus, the moon on a clear night.

This site holds both sides of that: where I study, and what I see along the way.
